Title: [Profile] - Verify Phone Number Management (Add, Edit, Delete)
Description: To verify the complete lifecycle of a phone number record within the User Profile: Adding a new number, Editing it, and Deleting it.
Precondition: User is logged in to https://app.datascend.net > Profile Page.
Steps:
Click on the User Avatar in the top navbar and select "Profile".
Scroll to the "Phone Number List" section and click "Add Phone Number".
Select "Mobile" from the Phone Type dropdown and enter a valid number (e.g., +1 555 0000). Check the Active box. Click "Save".
Click the Edit button on the recently created number.
Change the Phone Type to "Work" and modify the number. Click "Save".
Click the Delete button on the same number.
Confirm the deletion.
ExpectedResult:
The Profile page loads displaying the "General Information" section.
A modal/form opens with fields: Phone Type, Phone Number, and Active checkbox.
The modal closes, success message appears, and the new number is visible in the list.
The form opens with the previous data pre-filled.
The list updates immediately showing the new Type and Number.
A confirmation modal appears: "Are you sure you want to delete the user phone?".
The record disappears from the list.

Title: [Users] - Verify The Process to Delete an User
Description: Verify that a user can be permanently deleted regardless of whether they have dependencies, and that record ownership is correctly handled (reassigned or set to NULL).
Precondition:
Have valid log in credentials to enter to the site  https://app.datascend.net
Have at least one user in the users list
Steps:
Log in with valid credentials.
Navigate to Users.
Locate a user in the list (with or without dependencies).
Open the ⋮ menu and select Delete.
Select Permanent Deletion.
(Optional) Select a user in the reassignment dropdown.
Confirm the deletion.
Verify the users list.
(Only if the user had records) Navigate to an entity and open a record previously created by the deleted user.
Validate the Owner field.
ExpectedResult:
Make sure the "home" page is displayed.
The users list is displayed.
The user is displayed with correct details.
The delete modal is displayed with available options.
The option is highlighted (red border) and expands showing the reassignment dropdown and informational message about NULL ownership.
The selected user is set as the new owner of the records.
The system permanently deletes the user and displays a success toast message.
The deleted user no longer appears in the list.
The record edit view is displayed successfully.
If reassignment was selected: the Owner matches the selected user. 
If not selected: the Owner is NULL or empty.

Title: [Users] - Happy Path - End-to-End User Creation Flow
Description: This test case verifies the complete and successful flow of creating a new user through the multi-step wizard. Validation covers navigation between the different tabs (Basic Information, Addresses, Account, etc.), the addition of sub-records via modals (such as addresses and phone numbers), and the final creation and persistence of the new user record.
Precondition:
The user is logged in to the environment: https://app.datascend.net/.
The user has a role with the necessary permissions to create new users.
Steps:
From the main dashboard, navigate to the Users section, either through the top navigation menu or the module on the Welcome page.
Click the "Add User" button.
Complete all required fields on the "Basic Information" tab and click "Next."
On the "Addresses" tab, click "Add Address."
Complete the fields in the address modal and click "Save."
Hacer clic en el botón "Siguiente".
In the current tab, complete the required fields. Click "Add Phone."
Select a phone type, enter a valid number in the modal, and click "Save."
Click the "Next" button
Complete all required fields in the "Account" tab (Username, Email, Password) and click the "Save" button.
Inspect the list of users.
ExpectedResult:
The system displays the list view with all existing users.
The system redirects to the user creation wizard, displaying the first tab of the form: "Basic Information."
The form accepts the data without any validation errors. The view changes to the "Addresses" tab.
A modal opens with fields for the address (Street, City, State, etc.).
The modal closes. A new row with the saved address information appears in the table on the "Addresses" tab.
The view changes to the next tab in the form (either "Additional Information" or "Contact").
A modal opens with fields for the type and phone number.
The modal closes. A new row with the saved phone number information appears in the phone table.
The view changes to the last tab of the form: "Account".
The system processes all entered information. A success notification is displayed (e.g., "Account created successfully"), and the system redirects the user back to the Users list view.
System prevents adding users when MAX_USERS limit is reached
The users table now contains a new row corresponding to the newly created user record, confirming that the entire process was successful.

Title: [Users] - Verify that the user edit view shows the required fields and includes the Roles and Domains tabs.
Description: Validate that when editing an existing user, the view displays the required fields (First name, Last name, Email address, Password) plus two additional tabs — Roles and Domains — that allow assigning roles and domains to the user.
Precondition:
The user is logged in to the environment: https://app.datascend.net/.
The user has a role with the necessary permissions to create new users.
Steps:
Go to DatAscend and log in with valid Administrator credentials.
Navigate to the Users section and locate an existing user in the table.
Click on the user to open it in edit mode.
Observe the tabs available in the edit view.
Click on the Roles tab.
Click on the Domains tab.
Modify a field value and save.
ExpectedResult:
The user logs in successfully and the dashboard is displayed.
The user table is displayed with the existing users.
The user edit view opens displaying the required fields: First name, Last name, Email address, and Password, pre-populated with the user's existing data.
In addition to the main fields, two tabs are visible: Roles and Domains. No other secondary or legacy tabs are present.
The Roles tab opens displaying the roles currently assigned to the user and the option to assign or remove roles.
The Domains tab opens displaying the domains currently assigned to the user and the option to assign or remove domains.
The user is updated successfully. A confirmation message is displayed.

Title: [Users] - Verify safe deactivation of a user with or without dependencies
Description: Verify that Safe Deactivation disables user access, preserves record ownership (if applicable), and allows reactivation with correct UI behavior and localization.
Precondition:
Logged in as a user with Administrator role.
At least one user exists in the system.
Steps:
Log in with valid Administrator credentials.
Navigate to Users.
Locate a user in the list.
Open the ⋮ menu and select Delete.
Confirm Safe Deactivation.
Filter the list by inactive users.
Locate the deactivated user.
Attempt to log in using the deactivated user credentials.
(Only if the user had records) Navigate to an entity and open a record created by the deactivated user.
Validate the Owner field.
Click Activate on the user row.
Confirm the activation.
Verify the user state in the list.
Change the application language (ES/EN).
ExpectedResult:
The Dashboard is displayed successfully.
The users list is displayed.
The user is displayed with correct details.
The delete modal is displayed with available options.
A success toast is displayed and the user status changes to inactive.
Inactive users are displayed.
The row has reduced opacity. The Delete button is not visible. The Activate button (green outline) is visible next to Edit.
The system rejects the login and displays an error message.
The record edit view is displayed successfully.
The Owner remains unchanged (the deactivated user is still assigned).
A confirmation modal is displayed with the user name highlighted in bold.
A success toast is displayed.
The row returns to full opacity  and the Activate button changes back to Delete.
Modal texts and toast messages are displayed correctly according to the selected language.
